summary: LCI Industries filed an 8-K disclosing that it voluntarily withdrew its HSR Act premerger notification on September 4, 2026, and refiled on September 9, 2026, resetting the antitrust waiting period for its pending merger with Patrick Industries under the June 30, 2026 Merger Agreement. The two-step structure merges LCI into Patrick subsidiaries, with LCI becoming an indirect wholly owned Patrick subsidiary and Patrick issuing stock to LCI holders. Closing conditions include HSR clearance; a joint proxy/prospectus on Form S-4 is contemplated. Watch the new HSR clock, potential Second Request risk, and any merger-price arbitrage spread.
